evals.prompt: Add a public scholarships listing at /scholarships. Visitors filter by country and degree. The page has to be server-rendered, with a skeleton while the list loads, and a title Google can index. The scholarships table already exists.
evals.expected_output: A thin page shell passes searchParams into a Suspense child in src/features/scholarships. A matching skeleton exists. The list calls a cached query function rather than importing db. Country or degree with its own search demand is a path, or the query string follows the nuqs skill (parsers next to the route, not in the feature). No component file under src/app.
expectations: The page file under src/app does not import @/db or drizzle-orm
The page file does not await searchParams or params
The page wraps a component from src/features in Suspense
A skeleton component exists under src/features and uses Skeleton
The query function used by the list contains the string use cache
If search-params.ts exists, it is under src/app, not under src/features
src/app contains only route files (page, layout, loading, error, not-found, search-params, route), not a presentational component

evals.prompt: Signed-in users need a form on the scholarship detail page to save a scholarship with a short note. Validate the note, show errors, and confirm when it saves.
evals.expected_output: A client form uses React Hook Form, zodResolver, shadcn Field, and useTransition. The server action uses validatedActionWithUser and updateTag after the write. Success uses toast.success from sonner. A feature test.ts covers the action or the validation seam and does not import db.
expectations: A form component imports useForm from react-hook-form and zodResolver
The form uses useTransition and calls toast.success from sonner
The server action uses validatedActionWithUser from @/lib/action-middlewares
The server action calls updateTag after the write
The action does not import @/db or drizzle-orm
src/features contains a test.ts that does not import @/db
validations.ts exports a Zod schema that the form and the action both use

evals.prompt: Add /scholarships/[slug] showing the name, who funds it, the deadline, and the amount. Google should index each scholarship.
evals.expected_output: The page is a server shell with generateMetadata, one h1, and semantic HTML. The detail component awaits params inside Suspense and calls a cached get-by-slug query. A detail skeleton matches the layout. The page does not import db and is not a client component.
expectations: The page exports generateMetadata
The page file does not start with use client and does not import @/db
The page wraps a feature detail component in Suspense
Either the page or the detail component contains a single h1
The detail component awaits params and calls a query function
That query function contains the string use cache
A detail skeleton file exists under src/features
